color.note: log10 of the showers per bin, empty bins transparent. A bin holding one shower is drawn at position 0.4 of Viridis, #29788e, 3.2:1 against the #1c2128 card: the ramp's own first colour, #440154, is 1.06:1 and would make a count of one disappear. Each offered palette has its own start in ramp.by_palette. Turbo darkens towards its end, so its peak is drawn at position 0.85, the last that clears 3:1.

axis.bin_rule: Freedman–Diaconis: bin width 2 · IQR · N^(−1/3), the widest among the drawn series so they share one binning, clamped to 8–120 bins over the axis. An exception to the Rice rule, for prediction residuals only: their tails are heavy, and a bin count set by the sample size alone spreads the core over a single bin of a range the tail sets, while the interquartile range follows the core

clipping.note: Display range covers the 1st to 99th percentile; 5 of 572 values (0.87%) lie outside it and are excluded from the view but not from the statistics.

axis.basis: pooled residuals of the showers with N ≥ 15

notes.pairs: Each count is a shower: shower A and shower B of an event are separate pairs and are drawn apart. Below N = 15 pairs a shower gets its individual (truth, prediction) pairs instead of a density, because a cell of one or two showers would be set by the binning, not by the network.
notes.axes: Truth and prediction share one range taken from the whole event table, whatever the selection, so the identity line is the diagonal and the picture does not move when a filter changes. Showers beyond it are counted in outside, never dropped silently.
notes.residual: The residual is the quantity of the model-performance cards. Its range is the 1st to 99th percentile of the pooled residuals of the showers with N ≥ 15, rounded outward, when at least 20 are pooled (axis.clipping.applied); below that the percentiles would be noise, the range is the full extent and axis.provisional is set. The showers beyond it are counted in axis.outside. From N = 15 a series is a density histogram, which is its spread, with its fitted Gaussian; its mean is a long-dashed rule with the 95 % Student-t interval of the mean as two thin hairlines. Below N = 15 its events are drawn in a reserved band, with the mean's capped Student-t whisker and an uncapped ± 1 SD bar, the spread of the events: two marks, two quantities.
notes.calibration: The energy network predicts the momentum scale directly; no sampling-fraction calibration is applied.
notes.relative: A relative residual needs a positive truth; a shower without one is left out and counted in residual.excluded.
